capabilities.name: positioning.physical_referencing
capabilities.description: Locates work by declared physical references. It does not acquire an image, measure a feature, estimate a transform, or apply compensation.

reference_types.description: Physical reference types accepted by this configuration, such as registration_pin, edge_stop, or fixture.

acquisition_methods.description: Methods that establish the physical reference, such as contact or mechanical_constraint.

target_scopes.description: Work-object scopes to which a reference can apply: piece, sheet, panel, or segment.

capabilities.name: positioning.feature_detection
capabilities.description: Detects declared visual or sensed features. Detection alone neither estimates a registration transform nor applies a compensation.

detectable_features.description: Feature classes detectable in this configuration, such as registration_mark, edge, corner, or fiducial.

acquisition_methods.description: Feature-acquisition methods, such as optical_sensor, camera_image, or manual_input.

identifiable_mark_profiles.description: Stable producer-defined profiles of marks that this configuration can identify.

minimum_feature_size.description: Smallest declared feature size detectable under the configuration conditions.

reference_requirements.description: Named reference conditions needed by detection, such as two_registration_marks or physical_edge.

capabilities.name: positioning.transformation_estimation
capabilities.description: Estimates a declared coordinate transformation from supplied references. It does not move equipment or apply that estimate.

transform_models.description: Supported model identifiers, such as translation_2d, rigid_2d, similarity_2d, affine_2d, or projective_2d.

target_scopes.description: Work-object scopes for an estimate: piece, sheet, panel, or segment.

registration_extents.description: Whether an estimate is declared global, local, or both within one configuration.

minimum_reference_count.description: Minimum number of references required by the declared model in this configuration.

error_metric.description: Named positional-error metric, for example maximum_absolute_position_error.

max_position_error.description: Declared bound for error_metric when its stated configuration conditions apply.

error_conditions_id.description: Stable identifier for the declared conditions of the error assertion; it is not a calibration or uncertainty claim.

capabilities.name: positioning.compensation_application
capabilities.description: Applies a declared compensation to coordinates in the selected configuration. It does not imply feature detection, transform estimation, motion, or physical success.

accepted_transform_sources.description: Sources accepted for compensation, such as external_estimate, local_estimate, or manual_input.

transform_models.description: Transformation models that this configuration can apply.

target_scopes.description: Work-object scopes for compensation: piece, sheet, panel, or segment.

registration_extents.description: Whether the configuration can apply global, local, or both declared compensations.
